SELECT s.site_id, s.site_code, s.site_name, s.domain, s.default_lang, s.parent_site_id, s.template_id, s.theme_id, s.layout_id, s.default_yn, s.sort_order, s.use_yn, t.template_code, th.theme_code, l.layout_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_menu m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id AND m.delete_yn = 'N') AS menu_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_content c WHERE c.site_id = s.site_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N') AS content_count FROM tb_site s LEFT JOIN tb_template t ON t.template_id = s.template_id LEFT JOIN tb_theme th ON th.theme_id = s.theme_id LEFT JOIN tb_layout l ON l.layout_id = s.layout_id
ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.site_code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT site_id, site_code, site_name, domain, default_lang, parent_site_id, template_id, theme_id, layout_id, default_yn, sort_order, logo_path, favicon_path, description, head_meta, copyright, use_yn FROM tb_site WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_site (site_id, site_code, site_name, domain, default_lang, parent_site_id, template_id, theme_id, layout_id, default_yn, sort_order, logo_path, favicon_path, description, head_meta, copyright, use_yn) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{siteName}, #{domain}, #{defaultLang}, #{parentSiteId}, #{templateId}, #{themeId}, #{layoutId}, #{defaultYn}, #{sortOrder}, #{logoPath}, #{faviconPath}, #{description}, #{headMeta}, #{copyright}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_site SET site_code = #{siteCode}, site_name = #{siteName}, domain = #{domain}, default_lang = #{defaultLang}, default_yn = #{defaultYn}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, logo_path = #{logoPath}, favicon_path = #{faviconPath}, description = #{description}, head_meta = #{headMeta}, copyright = #{copyright}, use_yn = #{useYn}, parent_site_id = #{parentSiteId}, template_id = #{templateId}, theme_id = #{themeId}, layout_id = #{layoutId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE site_id = #{siteId}
UPDATE tb_site SET delete_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE site_id = #{siteId}
UPDATE tb_site SET default_yn = 'N', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE default_yn = 'Y' AND site_id <> #{siteId}
